'''July 2000 Huntsville tournament (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Deep, Huntsville, AL on 29 July 2000. [[Brandon Ruck]] won it. It is known from Josh Koziura's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1057">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-huntsville-al-7-29-00d1057/ huntsville-al-7-29-00], DeckTech (Josh "Blue1138" Koziura, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-huntsville-al-7-29-00d1057/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2000
* '''Site:''' The Deep, Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Ruck]]
